final: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'h' AND b.bond_type = '#') / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'), 2) as percentage
